question: Giorgio Parisi won the Nobel Prize 2021 in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Physics.**__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Giorgio Parisi **takes his Nobel Prize on **Wednesday 8 December 2021**__. ** **
 
• Giorgio Parisi also won Wolf Award(2021), and the Max Planck medal (2021). 
 
• He was awarded the 2021 Nobel Prize for Physics for his work on spin glasses**, which proved widely applicable in the study of complex systems.
 
• **Spin spectacles are liquid equipment into which many glamorous titles are introduced.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nobel prizes are provided yearly for great work in physics, chemistry, physiology or medicinal drug, literature, economics, and the promotion of peace.**
 
• **The Nobel Prizes, first offered in 1901, are decided via contributors of Swedish found out societies or, in the case of the peace prize, the Norwegian Parliament.**
 
• ​A never-ending exploration was driven by means of intellectual passion.
 
• The Nobel Prize in Literature 2021 turned into awarded to Abdulrazak Gurnah for his uncompromising and compassionate penetration of the results of colonialism and the fate of the refugee in the gulf among cultures and continents.”

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Other Nobel prize winner in 2021.

• **Nobel Prize in Literature- Abdulrazzak Gurnah.**
